  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED') THEN channel_order_id END) AS outstanding_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED') THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pending_reconciliation_value,
  AVG(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED') THEN DATEDIFF(day, TRY_CAST(channel_order_time AS TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_DATE) END) AS avg_pending_age_days
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE metadata_2 = 'mensa brand technologies private limited'
  AND is_active = true
  AND sales_channel IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY pending_reconciliation_value DESC, avg_pending_age_days DESC;"}
